zh.title: 民航局無人機與先進空中交通論壇登場 聚焦國際發展及航空安全規範
zh.summary: 民航局無人機與先進空中交通論壇11月23日登場，聚焦國際發展及航空安全規範。
body: 交通部民用航空局11月23日舉辦「2026國際無人機及先進空中交通論壇」。論壇聚焦國際無人機與先進空中交通發展，以及國際航空安全規範，並邀請國外民航主管機關與專家分享實務經驗。
民航局表示，希望透過專家交流，讓臺灣無人機產業與制度和國際接軌。該局指出，先進空中交通從技術研發走向實際營運，仍須建立適航認證、安全監理與空域整合機制。
民航局長也在致詞中列舉無人機用途，包括空拍攝影、農業作業、監測巡檢、物流運送及緊急救援。

en.title: Taiwan CAA opens forum on drones and advanced air mobility
en.summary: Taiwan's CAA opens a drone and advanced air mobility forum on November 23, focusing on aviation safety standards.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) opened its 2026 international forum on drones and advanced air mobility on November 23. The forum focuses on international developments in drones and advanced air mobility and on aviation safety standards. Foreign civil aviation authorities and experts were invited to share practical experience.

The CAA said the forum is intended to help align Taiwan's drone industry and related systems with international practice. It said moving advanced air mobility from research and development to actual operations requires mechanisms for airworthiness certification, safety oversight and airspace integration.
The agency's director general also highlighted drone applications including aerial photography, agricultural work, monitoring and inspections, logistics and emergency response.
